accessGaps: The selected free-source pass screened 24 filings, every page using RapidOCR with DirectML at 150 dpi. Selection covers formation, contribution, transformation, mergers and recent statutes; it is not every filing ever deposited. Prior shared links, searches and effort are reused without claiming the old PDFs were re-screened.

JFCM and Ponsot & Co remain unlinked: common surnames, individual officers and addresses do not establish the required company-to-domaine relationship. Ponsot & Co is distinct from Laurent Ponsot SAS.

GFA des Fossés, Nouvelle Elvina and John Harris No.1 Estate Investments Limited retain unresolved U-id company crosswalks. Perrot-Minot’s legal identity is supported by its exact AN64 filing, but no producer or contemporary tenant crosswalk is asserted.
Faiveley Musigny’s 980 m² and 220 m² acquisition mandates lack cadastral numbers. They are not corrected into AN45/46 by matching area and do not prove an executed tenancy.
Perrot-Minot’s official website returned HTTP 503. The 2023 statutes deposit date and exact Faiveley Musigny founding-statutes signing date remain unresolved.

Named-area holdings are published census context only. La Combe d’Orveau still lacks an accepted cadastral named-area outline, so Prieur’s published total is not assigned there or to individual parcels.
Original leases, renewals, paid SPF copies and outreach remain unreviewed. Tier 1 history source boundaries and notice gaps remain. Current farming is unconfirmed for every parcel.

All ten originally requested Musigny subscriber archives and the additional Faiveley acquisition WebArchive were supplied and reviewed; public articles were accessed directly. The full continuation leaves its earlier ownership chain uncertain, with no additional parcel match.

Public text-capture hashes identify extracted text; supplied MHTML and WebArchive hashes cover original archive bytes. The earlier Faiveley public capture remains separately identifiable. No archives, full article text or figures are committed.

Winehog reference matches are historical critic leads, not company identity crosswalks. Group totals, map legend numbers and unnumbered outlines are not substituted for individual references and areas. The reported Jadot lease lacks an executed instrument and present-scope confirmation.

Published holding totals vary by date and precision; those variations are retained. Incidental Roumier totals of 0.0966 ha in Tawse and 0.1669 ha in Faiveley do not override Roumier’s own 0.0996 ha sheet or its directly numbered critic account.
